get_memory_statistics: get memory statistics for the current CUDA or MPS device in gigabytes
free_memory: free GPU memory by collecting garbage, emptying the CUDA cache, and collecting IPC
make_contiguous: make a tensor or dict of tensors contiguous in memory
bytes_to_gigabytes: convert a byte count to gigabytes as a float value
test_memory_utils: test the memory utility functions for CUDA, MPS, and non-GPU environments
